nativeVisualAssessment: Previous two material native visual blockers resolved; ready for final consumer evidence and sealed packet. This is not formal approval.
observations: The revised side profiles materially improve the cluster: shortened bulging bodies, narrower feet and offset crowns now read as irregular boulders in all four facings. The upright column reading from draft-04 is resolved to a satisfactory provisional native level.

S shows the strongest three-step crown sequence; N/E/W have natural occlusion but coherent substantial boulder volume. Exact replication of the single target view in every rotation is neither possible nor required.

Both crevice regions now read as attached overlapping folded green clumps with more compact volumes. They retain green/light-green face variation while leaving broad rock crowns and side planes visible.

The consistent slate-blue/violet palette, large plane hierarchy and restrained rough shading preserve the improvement from the source. At logical 192x352 size on light and dark backgrounds, crown/side separation and green accents remain legible without dominant noise or clipping.
No final phone consumer was supplied for this draft because the coordinator is correcting the existing layout. Native visual assessment alone cannot grant final approval.
